title: Like-kind exchange: what property qualifies
rule: For exchanges completed after 2017, no gain or loss is recognized when real property held for productive use in a trade or business or for investment is exchanged solely for like-kind real property to be held for either use. Real property held primarily for sale does not qualify. Like kind looks to the nature of the property, not its grade or quality: improved and unimproved real estate are like kind; United States and foreign real property are not. Real property means land and improvements, and interests such as fee ownership, leaseholds, options and easements, but not notes, securities, most partnership interests or stock other than cooperative housing stock.
changeWatch: Amendments to Section 1031(a) or to 26 CFR 1.1031(a)-1 and 1.1031(a)-3 (the real property definition applies to exchanges beginning after December 2, 2020).
